text: This application proposes to permit a 5-storey, 18,835 square metre institutional building that would contain a 354-bed student residence as well as classrooms and office space, incorporate the existing George Ignatieff Theatre and connect to the existing Larkin Building, at 15 Devonshire Place and 6 Hoskin Avenue. The proposed development is consistent with the Provincial Policy Statement (2020), conforms with the Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe (2020) and conforms with the Official Plan. This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law.
